import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import io

# Prepare the data
csv_data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
"""

# Read the data into a pandas DataFrame
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# Data cleaning and feature engineering
df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None', inplace=True)
df[['Systolic', 'Diastolic']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True).astype(int)
df['BMI Category'] = pd.Categorical(df['BMI Category'], categories=['Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese'], ordered=True)

# Set up the visualization style
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="viridis")

# Create a 2x2 subplot grid for a comprehensive dashboard view
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Comprehensive Health and Sleep Analysis', fontsize=20, weight='bold')

# --- Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs. Stress Level, colored by Sleep Disorder ---
sns.scatterplot(
    ax=axes[0, 0],
    data=df,
    x='Stress Level',
    y='Sleep Duration',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    size='Physical Activity Level',
    sizes=(100, 400),
    alpha=0.8,
    edgecolor='black',
    style='BMI Category'
)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Stress & Physical Activity vs. Sleep', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Factors', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')


# --- Plot 2: Distribution of Key Health Metrics by Sleep Disorder ---
metrics_df = df.melt(
    id_vars=['Sleep Disorder'],
    value_vars=['Quality of Sleep', 'Stress Level'],
    var_name='Metric',
    value_name='Level'
)
sns.violinplot(
    ax=axes[0, 1],
    data=metrics_df,
    x='Metric',
    y='Level',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    split=True,
    inner='quart',
    palette={'None': 'g', 'Sleep Apnea': 'm'}
)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Sleep Quality & Stress by Disorder', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Health Metric', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Level (1-10)', fontsize=12)

# --- Plot 3: Blood Pressure Comparison ---
bp_melted = df.melt(id_vars='BMI Category', value_vars=['Systolic', 'Diastolic'], var_name='Pressure Type', value_name='Value')
sns.barplot(
    ax=axes[1, 0],
    data=bp_melted,
    x='BMI Category',
    y='Value',
    hue='Pressure Type',
    ci=None,
    palette='plasma'
)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Blood Pressure by BMI Category', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Blood Pressure (mmHg)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].axhline(120, color='grey', linestyle='--', label='Normal Systolic')
axes[1, 0].axhline(80, color='black', linestyle='--', label='Normal Diastolic')
axes[1, 0].legend()


# --- Plot 4: Daily Steps by Occupation and Sleep Disorder ---
sns.stripplot(
    ax=axes[1, 1],
    data=df,
    x='Occupation',
    y='Daily Steps',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    jitter=0.2,
    size=10,
    dodge=True,
    palette={'None': 'g', 'Sleep Apnea': 'm'}
)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Daily Steps by Occupation', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=15)

# Adjust layout and save the figure
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
